column1: # Dependencies nobody had written down, found while building Slackware from
# scratch.  Neither depgraph.db (ELF), the SlackBuild scanner nor
# source/MANIFEST.bz2 showed them; each one stopped a real build.
# Every line is also in manual.tsv or base.list, so the plan already uses it.

column4: where it shows up
l/glibc/libxcrypt.build runs autogen.sh (autoreconf) for the bundled libxcrypt
same (libxcrypt autogen.sh)
same (libxcrypt autogen.sh, libtoolize)
doc/libtool.1 is regenerated through build-aux/missing; the SlackBuild never names help2man
installpkg/makepkg look up xz, gzip, lzip, plzip, lbzip2, mcookie, tput with "which"; without it makepkg says "xz compression utility not found"
ld/libbfd/libctf link zlib; in stage 0 libtool took the host's libz.so.1 when $SFS had no zlib
tzcode Makefile defaults to CC=c99; /usr/bin/c99 is a wrapper script installed by the gcc package (d/gcc/c99.sh)

examples/rlfe is built against the INSTALLED readline headers and libreadline (NOTE in the SlackBuild); on a system without readline it fails with readline/readline.h missing.  Pass-1 override points rlfe at $PKG
the bundled DBD-mysql module runs mysql_config in Makefile.PL; hard failure without mariadb (depgraph only saw it as an ELF link)
bundled Net-SSLeay needs the openssl headers and libs
bundled XML-Parser needs expat
intltool needs the XML::Parser module that the perl package bundles
configure: "readline works only with flex" (bc is built --with-readline; lex is not accepted)
the Ada front end needs an existing gnat; gcc.SlackBuild also runs make gnatlib/gnattools unconditionally, so a build without Ada fails
gcc configure: "cargo is required to build rust" (gccrs); left out of the first gcc, built in pass 2 after d/rust
gawk 5.4.1 built without mpfr generates a broken options.cc: "#error 0Wabsolute-value does not have a Var() flag" (gawk bug, see gcc-help 2026-08); Slackware's gawk links mpfr and works
libgcobol/xmlparse.cc includes libxml/SAX2.h; depgraph saw gcc->libxml2 only as an ELF link.  COBOL left out of the first gcc, built in pass 2
gcc.SlackBuild runs "find . -name 'lib*so*' -exec patchelf --remove-rpath"; without patchelf the RPATHs stay (not fatal, but not Pat's package)
sqlite.SlackBuild configures --with-tclsh=/usr/bin/tclsh8.6 and builds sqltclsh; autosetup stops with "Tcl shell /usr/bin/tclsh8.6 is not executable"
SlackBuild adds -DSQLITE_ENABLE_ICU and calls icu-config; sqlite3.c fails with unicode/utypes.h missing.  depgraph had it only as an ELF link
configure --enable-gssapi (default of the SlackBuild): "gssapi.h not found".  The SlackBuild has WITH_GSS=NO for exactly this; used in stage 1, pass 2 rebuilds with GSS-API

the SlackBuild gets PYTHONDIR from "distutils.sysconfig", which Python 3.12 only has through setuptools' shim; Pat's magic order assumes an older setuptools is already installed.  Without it PYTHONDIR is empty and flit_core is installed to /

build/_builder.py does "import pyproject_hooks"; python-pip (and every "python3 -m build" package) fails with ModuleNotFoundError.  Pat's magic order lists pyproject-hooks after pip, which only works when an older copy is already installed
zstd.SlackBuild passes -DZSTD_LZ4_SUPPORT=ON; cmake stops with "Could NOT find LZ4".  depgraph had it as an ELF link, the flag matcher missed it (digits cut off "lz4")

pzstd is linked "-L ../../lib -lzstd" (Pat's dont.link.pzstd patch) but the cmake build puts libzstd elsewhere, so the INSTALLED libzstd is used; "ld: cannot find -lzstd" on a system without zstd.  Pass-1 override sets LIBRARY_PATH to $PKG
man/meson.build: "Program 'scdoc' not found"; the SlackBuild never names it
same man pages in scdoc; meson man-pages=auto drops them without scdoc, so the package differs from Pat's (found by looking, not by a failure)
--enable-man: "configure: error: xsltproc is missing"
the --enable-man pages are built with the DocBook XSL stylesheets, which Slackware ships inside ap/linuxdoc-tools
-Dman-pages=enabled: meson "Program 'rst2man rst2man.py' not found"
--enable-manpages: xsltproc and the DocBook stylesheets (inside linuxdoc-tools); found by the sweep, not by a failure
--enable-gtk-doc --enable-man (gtk-doc is inside linuxdoc-tools); sweep
-Dman=enabled (xsltproc + DocBook); sweep
-Dman=true (xsltproc + DocBook); sweep
-Dgtk_doc=true -Dman=true; sweep
--enable-docs (asciidoc/a2x, inside linuxdoc-tools); sweep
-Dman=enabled: the man pages are made by doxygen; sweep
-Ddocs=enabled; sweep
-Dman-pages=true (rst2man); sweep

all [build-system] requires of the python tarballs: data/pybuild.tsv (135 lines, generated by sfs-pybuild.py).  First one hit: python-pluggy needs python-setuptools_scm ("Unmet dependencies" from python -m build --no-isolation)
meson.build runs "git describe" through run_command(); meson stops when git is missing, although the result is only used inside a git checkout.  Pass-1 override uses "false"
-Dpython=enabled: the python bindings are generated from doxygen XML (doc/meson.build find_program(doxygen) is required even with docs off)
-Dbuild_wizard=ON (doxywizard); the ELF edge was only soft.  Pass-1 override builds without the wizard
-Dbuild_search=ON (doxysearch)
the SlackBuild runs trackbuild.linuxdoc-tools, which runs slacktrack
linuxdoc-tools.build unpacks its .src.rpm sources with "rpm2cpio | cpio"; rpm cannot come first (rpm -> dbus -> elogind -> linuxdoc-tools), the kit ships tools/rpm2cpio for pass 1
meson dependency("libudev") is required; no elogind binary links libudev, so depgraph had no edge
tools/meson-render-jinja2.py imports jinja2 (logind.conf, rules)
-Dman=enabled: make-man-index.py / make-directive-index.py import lxml through tools/xml_helper.py (seen in the build scripts, not by a failure)
the tarball has no configure and autogen.sh stops when "which git" fails (git is only used for submodule commands that do nothing in a tarball).  Pass-1 override sets GIT=true
--with-ldap: "configure: error: ldap.h not found"; a cycle (openldap -> cyrus-sasl -> krb5), pass-1 override builds without LDAP
--with-ldap, same cycle; pass-1 override builds without LDAP (seen in the SlackBuild before it failed)
--with-mysql=/usr: the sql plugin links -lmysqlclient ("ld: cannot find -lmysqlclient"); depgraph had it as a soft ELF edge
without a system fmt cmake downloads fmt-*.zip from github ("error: downloading ... failed"); header only, so no ELF edge
storage/duckdb applies its patch with "git apply" (Error 127).  Pass-1 override uses patch -p1
libwrap is static only (libwrap.a), so no ELF edge; openldap configure: "could not find TCP wrappers"
CMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang, CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=clang++, LLVM_USE_LINKER=lld: built with the previous llvm.  Pass-1 override uses gcc and the default linker, pass 2 rebuilds with clang
cargo fetch ignores the vendored crates (no .cargo/config.toml) and downloads from crates.io; fails without CA certificates.  Override (all passes) makes it use vendor/
downloads pci.ids/usb.ids with lftpget over https on every build (found by looking, not by a failure)
cargo fetch needs crates.io over https: the vendored tarball has only a stub wasmtime-c-api-impl, but --all-features needs the real one (Pat's binary has wasmtime)
solved offline: sfs-seeds.sh prefetches them on the host into seeds/cargo-home
fs/codegen.rs (build script) runs bindgen: "could not run bindgen"; the SlackBuild never names it
configure: "cannot find sphinx-build, cannot build documentation" (docs on by default)
Documentation/conf.py loads sphinx_rtd_theme as an extension: "Could not import extension sphinx_rtd_theme"
the Makefile builds the man pages with asciidoctor; the SlackBuild never names it
thread-test links "-L. -lefivar" with no make dependency on libefivar.so: with -j it races, on Pat's machine the installed library hides it.  Pass-1 override builds serially
cross-texi-linearize.patch uses AX_CC_FOR_BUILD before autoreconf; without autoconf-archive "@CC_FOR_BUILD@" stays in doc/Makefile (Error 127)
fdutils doc/Makefile "all: info dvi": texi2dvi needs TeX; the dvi is not shipped.  Override (all passes) builds only info

glib >= 2.80 builds its GIRs only when g-i is installed, and g-i needs glib: glib2 is built again right after g-i (!again in manual.tsv); found through harfbuzz "Couldn't find include GObject-2.0.gir"
--with-dejavufont=/usr/share/fonts/TTF/DejaVuSans.ttf (make: no rule for DejaVuSans.ttf); the SlackBuild also makes dejavu/hack .pf2 fonts when they are installed
the SlackBuild runs iucode_tool to make the microcode cpio
meson dependency("wayland-scanner"); a data-only package, so no ELF edge
xcomposite.pc requires xfixes; configure: "Package xfixes not found"; no ELF link

configure looks for a CA bundle to set the trust paths ("checking for trust module paths... could not find"); ca-certificates makes /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt when installed.  On the Oct 15 snapshot the plan put p11-kit (87) before ca-certificates (93)

configure looks for a CA bundle to set the trust paths ("checking for trust module paths... could not find"); ca-certificates makes /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt when installed.  Hidden until the Oct 15 snapshot, where ngtcp2 links gnutls (curl -> ngtcp2 -> gnutls -> p11-kit) and the plan put p11-kit (87) before ca-certificates (93)

the Makefile runs "ruby icd_generator.rb" to generate the loader sources (stamp-generator); "make: ruby: No such file or directory".  The SlackBuild never names ruby.  On the Oct 15 snapshot the plan put ocl-icd before ruby

gfxreconstruct includes <xcb/xcb_keysyms.h> ("fatal error: xcb/xcb_keysyms.h: No such file or directory"); the library is loaded with dlopen, so depgraph has no ELF edge.  Every other xcb/X11/wayland header of the source was already there (checked)

meson.build reads /usr/share/hwdata/pnp.ids ("ERROR: File /usr/share/hwdata/pnp.ids does not exist") and asks for hwdata.pc.  hwdata was line 382 because of the old manual edges hwdata -> lftp, ca-certificates, which the offline override made unnecessary (removed)

mesa-demos (built by mesa.SlackBuild) needs libdecor-0; without it meson falls back to "git clone --branch master" of libdecor (offline: "Git command failed").  Pat's mesa-demos-subprojects.tar.lz is empty because his system has libdecor.  The first run had network in pass 1, so it silently bundled libdecor master
